support_info.response_time: Usually within a few minutes on WhatsApp

faqs.question: Video isn't playing
faqs.answer: Check your connection, restart the stream, or try another server.

faqs.question: Channels aren't loading
faqs.answer: The channel may temporarily be unavailable. Try again later.

faqs.question: My subscription isn't active
faqs.answer: Contact support with your Omnivue account/activation information.
